_meta.title: Gate-3 masked-LoRA TRAINING forward/backward vs. paper-facing A_rightmul masked INFERENCE path -- integration matrix
_meta.scope: READ-only provenance audit. No GPU/TDX run. Every claim cites file:line actually read.
_meta.one_line_finding: Gate-3 training runs the FULL PLAINTEXT HuggingFace forward; the ONLY obfuscation is a rank-space orthogonal mask U on the LoRA adapters (which cancels in the forward). It does NOT touch any A_rightmul / residual-mask / folded-weight / masked-nonlinear machinery. The paper inference path implements all of those but over DETACHED constant folded weights, so it is not differentiable w.r.t. any trainable parameter.

plaintext_hf_model_path.evidence_quote: out = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn)  # model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(...).to('cuda') (load_model, L150-151). The entire attention/RoPE/RMSNorm/softmax/SwiGLU/residual stream is HF's own plaintext Qwen2 forward.

rank_masked_lora_only.evidence_quote: self.A_t = torch.nn.Parameter((U @ A0).contiguous())  # (r,in) ; self.B_t = torch.nn.Parameter((B0 @ U.T).contiguous())  # (out,r).  forward L75: lora = (x @ self.A_t.T) @ self.B_t.T  => B_t@A_t == B@A (mask cancels). Only the LoRA adapters are masked, and only in rank space (r x r orthogonal U, buffer L67). Base nn.Linear weights are frozen plaintext (L63-64).

calls_A_rightmul.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. gate3_worker.py imports only argparse/json/os/time/pathlib/torch and (lazily) transformers + gate3_tdx_client (L37-43, L148, L233). grep for 'right_multiply|A_rightmul|rmsnorm_core|masked_attention|n_res|folded' across gate3_worker.py / gate3_tdx_step.py / gate3_plain_multi.py returns only the word 'folded' inside a docstring (L32). The nonlinearities are computed inside HF's plaintext model, never via RightMultiplyNonlinearBackend.

masked_rmsnorm.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. RMSNorm is HF's internal Qwen2RMSNorm over the plaintext hidden state (inside model(...) at L218). There is no call to pllo.ops.nonlinear_islands.rmsnorm_core or the A_rightmul rmsnorm over a signed-permutation-masked state.

post_rope_masking.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. RoPE runs inside HF's plaintext attention. No per-head Q/K compatible masks (pairwise_rotation) and no apply_rope over masked q/k appear in the training path.

gqa_masked_cache.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. KV cache / GQA repeat_kv are handled by HF over plaintext keys/values inside model(...). No masked key_rope_tilde / value_tilde cache. (Training uses a single full-sequence forward L218, so no incremental cache is needed at all.)

swiglu_island.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. The MLP is HF's plaintext Qwen2MLP (SiLU(gate)*up) inside model(...). No shared-channel-permutation SwiGLU island (_masked_mlp) is invoked. When targets=='attn_mlp' (L199) the gate/up/down projections merely get a rank-masked LoRA adapter (same cancelling U), not the channel-permutation island.

inter_block_hidden_masked.evidence_quote: NOT FOUND. The residual stream / hidden states flowing between the 24 decoder layers are HF's plaintext hidden states. There is no residual mask N_res applied to the hidden state (x @ n_res) and no per-layer handoff N_ell^-1 @ N_ell+1. The GPU sees plaintext hidden states everywhere; only the LoRA rank space carries a mask.

backward_through_masked_hidden.evidence_quote: loss.backward()  -- autograd runs through the PLAINTEXT HF graph; the trainable leaves are the masked adapters A_t,B_t so grads emerge already in the masked rank basis (gradA_t = U gradA, per docstring L14-16). This is masked-domain SGD in RANK space ONLY. The hidden states the gradient flows through are plaintext, so 'backward through a masked hidden state' is NOT what happens. dlogits are private (TDX) at the logit boundary (L234-240), but the interior activations are unmasked.

masked_input.mask_convention: residual signed-permutation N_res (self._n0); GPU only ever sees embed[input_ids] @ N
masked_input.evidence_quote: def mask_embeddings(self, input_ids): return self.embed_plain(input_ids) @ self._n0   # 'h_tilde = embed[input_ids] @ N -- the only embedding the GPU sees'. Single-block analogue: llama_qwen_single_block.py:527 'x_tilde = x @ n_res'.

residual_transport.mask_convention: per-layer change-of-basis T_ell = N_ell^-1 @ N_ell+1 (orthogonal); shared-mask strategy makes every handoff the identity (needs_handoff L300-303)
residual_transport.evidence_quote: def handoff(self, ell): return self.residual_mask_inverses[ell] @ self.residual_masks[ell + 1]  ('T_ell = N_ell^{-1} @ N_{ell+1}'). Applied at L955-957: 'h_tilde = blk["y_tilde"] @ masks.handoff(ell)...'. The production folded_worker uses a single residual basis and threads y_tilde directly (no per-step GEMM).

nonlinear_backend.mask_convention: compatible right-multiply / permutation: SiLU(gate@P)*(up@P)==(SiLU(gate)*up)@P; softmax over score-preserving Q~K~^T; rmsnorm over signed-permutation-masked state. zero trusted crossings
nonlinear_backend.evidence_quote: def silu(self, x): return self._on_accelerator(x, F.silu(x), 'silu')  (softmax L92, rmsnorm L108-113). Dispatched into the folded worker via folded_worker.py:126 _rmsnorm and llama_qwen_single_block.py:503 'act = runner.silu(gate) if runner is not None else silu_reference(gate)'.

q_k_v_projections.mask_convention: folded wq/wk/wv_tilde = n_res_inv @ (rms1 * W) @ M{q,k,v}_block (per-head block-diag masks); wo_tilde = sv_block_inv @ W_o @ n_res
q_k_v_projections.evidence_quote: q_t = split_heads(_linear(r1_core_tilde, folded['wq_tilde'], folded['bq_tilde'], *_pad(folded,'wq_tilde')), nh)  (k_t,v_t L468-471). Fold at L420-423: 'wq_tilde': n_res_inv @ (rms1 * weights.q_proj_weight) @ mq_block.

post_rope_paired_masking.mask_convention: pairwise_rotation per-head Q/K masks that are RoPE-compatible + score-preserving (Nq Nk^T == I, enforced by compatible_mask_verify.assert_qk_compatible)
post_rope_paired_masking.evidence_quote: qr_t = apply_rope(q_t, cos, sin, position_ids=position_ids); kr_t_new = apply_rope(k_t, cos, sin, position_ids=position_ids)  -- RoPE is applied to the ALREADY-masked q_t/k_t; correctness holds because the attention family is pairwise_rotation (compatible_mask_verify.py:59 COMPATIBLE_ATTENTION_MASK_FAMILIES=('pairwise_rotation',); assert_qk_compatible L135-146 requires Nq Nk^T == I).

gqa_attention.mask_convention: GQA via kv_index-expanded value masks; scores = Q~ K~^T are the true scores, softmax on accelerator, av @ folded o carries result back into masked basis
gqa_attention.evidence_quote: scores, probs, av = _sdpa(qr_t, repeat_kv(kr_t, nh, nkv), repeat_kv(v_full, nh, nkv), scale, causal_offset, runner=runner). value-mask GQA expansion at fold L410-411 'v_inv_qhead = attn["value_mask_inverses"].index_select(0, attn["kv_index"])'.

swiglu_shared_perm.mask_convention: single shared channel permutation 'perm' on gate/up (index_select(1,perm)) and down (index_select(0,perm) @ n_res); verified is_permutation_index
swiglu_shared_perm.evidence_quote: act = runner.silu(gate) if runner is not None else silu_reference(gate); hidden = act * up (L503-504). Fold L428-430: 'wgate_tilde'/'wup_tilde' = n_res_inv @ (rms2 * W).index_select(1, perm); 'wdown_tilde' = down.index_select(0, perm) @ n_res.

second_rmsnorm.mask_convention: post-attention RMSNorm core over the signed-permutation-masked residual x1_tilde (invariant: rmsnorm_core(x @ N)==rmsnorm_core(x) @ N)
second_rmsnorm.evidence_quote: with _region(timer, 'nonlinear'): r2 = _rmsnorm(x1, eps, runner)  (single_block analogue L532 'r2_core_tilde = rmsnorm_core(x1_tilde, eps)'). _rmsnorm L126-133 dispatches runner.rmsnorm_core or rmsnorm_core.

inter_block_remask.mask_convention: production path uses ONE shared residual basis, so the block output y_tilde stays in-basis and is fed straight to the next layer (h = out['y_tilde']); no per-block re-mask GEMM. Per-layer masks would insert masks.handoff(ell) (skeleton L955)
inter_block_remask.evidence_quote: h = out['y_tilde']; kv.append(out['cache'])  -- the folded_worker threads the masked hidden across layers with no explicit re-mask (shared-mask handoff == identity). See needs_handoff hf_causal_lm_skeleton.py:300-303.

output_logit_boundary.mask_convention: folded final-norm+LM-head w_lm_tilde (vocab mask baked in): logits_tilde = rmsnorm_core(h_tilde) @ w_lm_tilde; trusted recover(logits_tilde) = recover_vocab_logits(., vocab_mask)
output_logit_boundary.evidence_quote: def _final_head(self, h_tilde): return rmsnorm_core(h_tilde, self.eps) @ self._w_lm_tilde (L182). recover L150-151: 'return recover_vocab_logits(logits_tilde, self._vocab_mask)'. Worker analogue folded_worker.py:358 apply_folded_head.

gaps.item: Gate-3 training never invokes the masked inference forward at all
gaps.detail: The pure masked worker operators apply_folded_layer_prefill (folded_worker.py:194), _masked_attention (llama_qwen_single_block.py:457), _masked_mlp (L491) and _rmsnorm (folded_worker.py:126) are built from ordinary differentiable torch ops (matmul, rsqrt, softmax, silu, index_select). They are directly reusable as a training forward, but gate3 calls HF's plaintext model instead and applies masking only in LoRA rank space. Unifying = replace the HF forward with a per-layer loop over apply_folded_layer_prefill (causal_offset=0, no cache).

gaps.item: Folded weights are LoRA-blind: the adapter delta is not inside the fold
gaps.detail: Each *_tilde operator (e.g. wq_tilde = n_res_inv @ (rms1 * q_proj_weight) @ mq_block, L420) folds only the FROZEN base weight. For masked-domain LoRA training the folded operator must be W_tilde(theta) = fold(W_base + scaling * B(theta) A(theta)) so that d logits / d(A_t,B_t) is non-zero. folded_worker._maybe_merge_lora (L263-277) only merges a *frozen* folded-LoRA package (W_tilde += a_tilde @ b_tilde) -- a_tilde/b_tilde are constants, not autograd leaves. No trainable-LoRA fold exists anywhere. This is the core missing piece.

gaps.item: Base/affine weights are detached at extraction, severing every gradient path
gaps.detail: w = module.weight.detach().to(...).t().contiguous() (L231) and the layernorm weights detach+clone (L251-254). Every folded operator is therefore a constant w.r.t. autograd. Even if a training loop reused _masked_attention/_masked_mlp, no gradient could reach a trainable parameter because the fold inputs are detached. A training fold must keep the trainable LoRA tensors attached (skip .detach() for the LoRA contribution).

gaps.item: Residual mask N_res and rank mask U are trusted-only / per-module and not co-located for a unified backward
gaps.detail: The inference residual mask self._n0 (L108), per-head attn masks and SwiGLU perm live in the trusted boundary's mask bundle; the worker never holds them. The training worker's rank mask U lives as a per-MaskedLoRALinear buffer (gate3_worker.py:67). A unified masked-training forward must fix a compatible N_res AND the per-layer attn/SwiGLU masks as constant buffers held alongside the trainable A_t,B_t, so the backward collapses (gradA_t = U^T ... , gradient stays in the masked basis). Today these two mask systems are in different modules and never combined.

gaps.item: KV cache tensors are inference-only and must be excluded from the training forward
gaps.detail: past_key_rope/past_value concat (L474-478) and the returned key_rope_full/value_full (L487) exist to serve incremental single-token decode (apply_folded_layer_decode, folded_worker.py:228). Training uses a single full-sequence prefill with causal_offset=0 and past_key_rope=None (L529), so the cache is computed-then-discarded and is training-irrelevant. Confirmed excludable.

gaps.item: The verification wrappers recompute a plaintext reference and call .item(), which a training forward must avoid
gaps.detail: hf_single_block_masked_prefill runs plain = hf_single_block_plain_prefill(...) (L525) and a metrics dict full of _mx()/.item() host syncs (L539-565). Those are for validation only. The training path should call the pure worker ops (apply_folded_layer_prefill), which produce ONLY y_tilde + cache with no plain recompute and no .item() (folded_worker.py:194-225).

autograd_breaks.why_it_breaks_training: Detaches the base Linear weight before folding, so wq/wk/wv/wo/wgate/wup/wdown_tilde are autograd constants. No gradient can flow from logits back to any weight/LoRA parameter through the masked forward.
Detaches (and clones) the projection biases folded into b*_tilde; any bias-carried gradient path is severed.
Detaches the input-RMSNorm affine weight folded into wq/wk/wv_tilde (rms1 * W), so the pre-attention norm scale is a training constant.
Detaches the post-attention RMSNorm affine weight folded into wgate/wup_tilde (rms2 * W), a training constant.

_folded_layer re-extracts (hence re-detaches, via the L231/234/251/253 detaches) the base weights on every worker call, so worker_prefill/worker_decode produce logits that are constant w.r.t. any trainable parameter.

NOT a break for the training step itself -- this no_grad guards the POST-step 'next-step logits' diagnostic (L266-269), computed after opt.step(). It only matters that if the masked inference forward were reused for the trained step, this block would have to stay outside the graph. Listed for completeness.

autograd_breaks.code: loss_val, full_dlogits = tdx_logits_loss(args.tdx_url, fl.detach(), lab.detach(), valid.detach(), ...)
autograd_breaks.why_it_breaks_training: The tensors SENT to TDX are detached (correctly -- they cross the wire), but the training graph is preserved because the surrogate loss L240 'loss = (fl * full_dlogits).sum()' uses the NON-detached fl. So this detach does NOT break training; it is the intended private-boundary cut. Listed to show the boundary is handled correctly in gate3 and must be replicated in a unified path.
